gfi_title: Fat production & encapsulation within oleaginous yeast
scope_note: Food fat ingredient; feed use not considered
vietnam_angle: Weak: Vietnam has cassava sugar but produces coconut and imports palm oil, both cheaper than any modelled microbial oil
vietnam_evidence: Ideal single-cell oil plant sells at USD 1.81/kg (8,000 t/yr) to 1.20/kg (48,000 t/yr), whole-cell case 0.81; palm oil USD 1.12/kg and coconut oil USD 1.85/kg in August 2026; Vietnam has no microbial-oil fermenter
verdict_note: Bulk fermentation fat cannot pay for sugar and capital at palm-oil prices; the encapsulation idea has no Vietnamese user
signal_to_watch: A fermentation fat sold below USD 2/kg; a Vietnamese plant-based maker buying a fermentation fat

vietnam_angle: None: the problem arises in continuous airlift Fusarium plants, which Vietnam does not have; T9 is solid-state
vietnam_evidence: No Vietnamese continuous mycoprotein plant found; the package rates mycoprotein as one to watch (ch10 10.5)
verdict_note: Process improvement Vietnam would gain only by licensing a mature mycoprotein process
signal_to_watch: A mycoprotein licensor offering plants in Southeast Asia; FW-05 opening (new-food route plus food-grade pilot plant)

gfi_title: Techno-economic models to inform product and process development
vietnam_angle: Moderate: Vietnam lacks an open cost model with local inputs, which P6 proposes
vietnam_evidence: GFI and Hawkwood publish a downloadable TEA dataset and incumbent price compilation (2025); biomass protein USD 4 to 6/kg, microbial oils USD 1.5 to 19.6/kg in published models
verdict_note: Adds to P6: start from the public dataset and spend new effort on Vietnamese inputs (S12) and the domestic protein-ingredient price series
signal_to_watch: Licence terms of the GFI dataset; first Vietnamese use of it

gfi_title: Biosynthetic pathway discovery for fermentation-produced molecules
vietnam_angle: Weak: biodiverse microbes, but no biofoundry; Vietnam's ABS rules have no provision on digital sequence information
vietnam_evidence: No biofoundry in Vietnam (F3.5.2); 41 works on microbes of Vietnamese ferments, none on pathway discovery for food molecules
verdict_note: Vietnam would buy discovered molecules or design in Vietnam and build abroad (F3.5.2)
signal_to_watch: A regional biofoundry offering food-molecule discovery to Vietnamese teams; ABS rules on sequence data

gfi_title: Microbial strain-development contract research organizations for alternative protein applications
vietnam_angle: Weak: labour is cheap but there is no biofoundry or strain-engineering firm; T7 teams can buy the service
vietnam_evidence: Package already sets the route: design in Vietnam, build and test in a Korean, Singapore or Chinese biofoundry (F3.5.2)
verdict_note: Covered by T7 and F3.5.2; a Vietnamese contract strain developer has no buyer base
signal_to_watch: A Vietnamese T7 team buying strain work abroad; biofoundry access terms (F3 gap 11)

gfi_title: Developing open-access model production facility blueprints
vietnam_angle: Weak: Vietnam would use open blueprints for a T5 pilot line but has no reason to write them
vietnam_evidence: We found no open-access model facility blueprint from GFI as of October 2026 (search results only); Vietnamese plants are designed by foreign engineers (ch05 5.5)
verdict_note: Gap appears unfilled globally; Vietnam would be a user
signal_to_watch: Publication of an open fermentation facility blueprint

gfi_title: Comprehensive microbial screening to identify new protein production candidate strains
scope_note: Screening new strains for food protein
vietnam_angle: Moderate: VTCC holds over 15,000 strains; a research base on traditional starters (banh men, tuong); one Vietnamese screen found a 62 to 67% protein yeast without safety data; no genome or toxin characterisation of Vietnamese food moulds found
vietnam_evidence: VTCC 3,869 documented strains available domestically; 41 works on microbes of Vietnamese ferments; Phenikaa screen of 36 yeasts; Decree 43/2026 licence in about 19 working days with benefit sharing of at least 1% of revenue
verdict_note: SLF-C1: characterised Vietnamese food-strain set with standard licence terms; could instead be a T9 component
signal_to_watch: Firms asking VTCC or FIRI for characterised food strains; publication of genomes of Vietnamese food moulds
source_ids: SLF-01; SLF-02; SLF-03; SLF-04; SLF-05; SLF-06; REG-60

gfi_title: Expand capacity for demonstration-scale and mid-scale co-manufacturing
vietnam_angle: Moderate: no food-grade contract fermentation found; aerobic tanks captive in Vedan, Ajinomoto, Daesang; a domestic food yeast-protein maker (YERA) and Emmay are likely users
vietnam_evidence: Metrosert (Estonia) open food-grade 50 to 5,000 L pilot plant with drying, construction contract close to EUR 2 million (2026); ScaleUp Bio (Singapore) and EECi (Thailand) already offer pilot capacity; YERA invested VND 100 billion in Nghe An (claim)
verdict_note: Adds to T5: a foreign cost anchor, named domestic users and regional competitors for the same users
signal_to_watch: A tolling offer from Vedan, Ajinomoto or YERA; a funded T5 host; Vietnamese bookings at ScaleUp Bio or EECi
source_ids: SLF-11; RDL-01; AIS-39; RGN-10; RGN-36; INF-02

gfi_title: Producing animal-like fats through microbial fermentation
vietnam_angle: Weak: no microbial-oil fermenter in Vietnam; buyers would be plant-based makers at very low doses
vietnam_evidence: Fermentation fats on sale are low-dose flavour fats made under contract by a Chinese arachidonic-acid producer (CABIO for Nourish); bulk cost floor above palm and coconut oil
verdict_note: Vietnam would buy these ingredients, or a Vietnamese team could develop one under the T7 contract model
signal_to_watch: Regulatory clearances and prices of fermentation fats in Asia; a Vietnamese maker using one

gfi_title: Expanding options for food-safe genetic selection markers
vietnam_angle: Weak: matters only for GMO strain work under Decree 43/2026, which is a global tool question
vietnam_evidence: No Vietnamese work found; package covers GMO product status for precision fermentation (ch07, ch10 10.7)
verdict_note: A global research tool; Vietnam would use published marker sets
signal_to_watch: An open database of food-safe selection markers

gfi_title: Directories of contract manufacturers for plant-based production, fermentation, and animal cell culture
vietnam_angle: Weak: the package already lists Vietnamese co-packers and suppliers
vietnam_evidence: GFI runs a contract-manufacturing database and GFI APAC an ecosystem database with co-manufacturers and pilot facilities; its tables did not load, so Vietnamese entries were not checked
verdict_note: Covered by ch05 5.6 and S8.8; submitting Vietnamese co-packers and pilot centres to the GFI APAC database is housekeeping
signal_to_watch: Vietnamese entries appearing in the GFI APAC ecosystem database

gfi_title: Database of facility engineering, design, and construction firms
vietnam_angle: Weak: Vietnam relies on foreign designers and local fit-out contractors
vietnam_evidence: Package lists 9 engineering and equipment suppliers; three searches found no local maker of stainless fermenters or pilot bioreactors (search-level, weak)
verdict_note: Covered by S8.8 and engineering_suppliers.csv; OQ-031 stays open and needs a call
signal_to_watch: A local fabricator qualifying sanitary pressure vessels; Vietnamese service entities of GEA or Alfa Laval

gfi_title: Data lake for aggregating process data and informing process improvements
vietnam_angle: None now: Vietnam has almost no food-protein fermentation producers to pool data
vietnam_evidence: Only YERA and a few small firms ferment food protein; scales unpublished
verdict_note: No producer base; P6 covers the useful part (costs and prices)
signal_to_watch: Three or more Vietnamese food fermenters operating at pilot scale or above

vietnam_evidence: Package found no local maker of sanitary fermenters; GEA supplied a 2026 precision-fermentation scale-up line in the Netherlands (search snippet)
verdict_note: Vietnam would buy bioreactors from established makers; a Vietnamese bioreactor company has no local reason
signal_to_watch: Local service entities for bioreactor makers; a Vietnamese fabricator entering sanitary vessels

gfi_title: Repurposing and retrofitting facilities for use in alternative protein manufacturing
vietnam_angle: Negative: idle ethanol plants are being pulled back to fuel by E10; breweries are anaerobic
vietnam_evidence: May 2026: domestic ethanol about 25,000 m3/month against 92,000 to 100,000 demand, imports about 75,000 m3/month, about USD 1 billion a year; GFI's cited retrofit (Superbrewed) paused in 2024 and moved to contract manufacturing; Heineken Quang Nam brewery suspended since June 2024
verdict_note: Adds a constraint to T5 and support to RM-15: no Vietnamese ethanol plant is a realistic protein retrofit before 2030; used equipment from abroad and contract capacity are the routes
signal_to_watch: Domestic ethanol output reaching E10 demand; a brewery site offered for food use; distressed fermenters for sale in Asia
source_ids: SLF-13; SLF-12; SLF-14; IND-20; IND-25; FS-09
